overview.

This project demonstrates a hybrid automation testing framework that tests both API and UI layers of web applications — and connects them. Using Playwright and Python, the framework covers authentication, full CRUD API operations, UI interactions, and a hybrid test pattern that creates data via API and verifies it appears correctly on the UI.

objective.

To demonstrate full-stack QA coverage by building a framework that goes beyond clicking buttons — testing the API layer directly, validating data integrity across both layers, and proving that what the backend creates is what the frontend actually displays.

test coverage.

Total Automated Test Cases Executed: 11

  • All Passing: 11

tested across two applications:

  • Restful-Booker API — authentication token generation, invalid credential handling

  • DemoQA Bookstore API — token generation, get all books, add book to user collection, invalid credential handling

  • DemoQA Bookstore UI — page load, book display, search filtering, login, hybrid API-to-UI verification

key engineering decisions & lessons learned.

  • Chose Playwright's built-in request context over a separate tool like Postman or requests-only — keeping API and UI testing in a single unified framework

  • Discovered that DemoQA's ad scripts prevent networkidle from ever firing — switched to wait_until="commit" which fires as soon as the server responds, before ads load

  • Implemented pre-test cleanup after discovering that duplicate book additions return 400 — a real-world data integrity issue that required defensive test design

  • The hybrid test — adding a book via API then verifying it in the browser profile — was the most valuable test in the suite, proving both layers work correctly and in sync
